name: Kempen (Germany)
description: Hanging banner divided vertically blue and red, charged above the centre with the city arms of Kempen (a black cross with a crescent and star on white and red).
history: The banner shows the colours blue and red striped lengthwise 1:1 with the arms in a shield slightly above the centre; for general use a flag without the shield may also be flown.

features.role: Kempen arms — cross with crescent and star
